A) [Seif 1] Let him be strong as a lion … awaken at dawn. Shelah writes pairing day and night in Torah or prayer morning and evening. Magen Avraham subparagraph 1 … Eliyah Rabbah … Shiyurei Kneses … Rabbi Zeira … Rabbi Chanina …
B) Rema: Shevisi Lord … visualize four-letter Name constantly before eyes—great benefit for awe and purifying soul; Shaar Ruach HaKodesh Yichud each day.
C) Rema: not ashamed … nevertheless do not quarrel—Beis Yosef; Magen Avraham subparagraph 2.

D) Rema: immediately measure sleep—not literal—pause briefly not stand suddenly after sleep Magen Avraham subparagraph 3 … Eliyah Rabbah … Seder HaYom Modeh Ani … no netilah though dirty—no Name … Shiyurei Keneses p. 17d … Chayei Adam … Kitzur Shulchan Aruch 1:2 … although Chida in Kesher Gudal writes some require netilah for Modeh Ani—majority poskim say no—we rule leniently.

E) Say this formula lying or sitting … Rabbi Zeira … pause between “bechamela” and “rabba” Kitzur Shulchan Aruch … but issuing oral Torah from dirty hands forbidden … Eliyahu Zuta … Shiyurei Keneses … Rabbi Zeira … see below siman 4 note 110.
F) Immediately upon awakening wash properly if not wishing to sleep while lying Shelah … Eliyahu Rabbah note 4 … Taz … Birkei Yosef note 1 citing Derech Chaim.

G) [Seif 2] Early supplicant … Zohar Vayigash Rabbi Zeira 71a praises one awake exactly Chatzos with intention; Nehar Shalom p. 6b: immediately after six of twelve night hours—Chatzos laylah—from midday when sun at zenith for everyone at equator climates day/night equal summer/winter; from sunset shadows evening twelve hours true Chatzos laylah—in winter night borrows hours from day start/end like two-thirds addition near day start one-third near end; summer day borrows from night similarly—Zohar Vayahel 295b seasonal hours not counted in twelve night hours—Tamid bein ha’arbayim from leaning shadows winter/summer—great proof Tamid time as stated—even summer many hours sunset to nightfall counts toward coming night’s start—after six night hours Chatzos—rise like lion lest sleep past Chatzos—for sleeping past Chatzos tastes death flavor cleaving evil spirit ruling from kelipah nogah—sleep at first Chatzos half upper nogah etc.—six night hours called sixty souls per Rav Zohar—sleep those six hours little or much called sixty souls lacking one—not tasting death … Zohar Vayigash—even sleeping after Chatzos after blessings Chatzos repair no harm … danger attachment before Chatzos passes sleeping … Mekor Chaim misquoted Ramaz Zohar without emendation—Arizal emended text … Rav Chaim Vital Shaar HaKavanos Drushei Laylah drush 4: if cannot stay awake entire Chatzos till morning may sleep afterward with great alacrity guarding soul awake exactly Chatzos especially if soul-root Yaakov-Leah pairing after Chatzos night—cited Shiyurei Keneses p. 17; Birkei Yosef note 5 Shevus Yaakov O.C. §1 twelve hours after midday is Chatzos laylah heavens equator earth; Ikrei HaDat §1 note 2; Beis Yosef note 2 Rabbi Zeira note 8 Eliyahu Tov note 6 writes principal opinion; Kaf HaChayim Maharchaf §3 note 33 consensus Gemara poskim accepted Lev Chaim I §6 Ruach Chaim §1 note 100 etc.; Ben Ish Chai Vayishlah note 4.

H) Even one awakened not exactly Chatzos but hour or two later must rise then—not say since missed Chatzos remain sleeping—earlier rising better lest kelipos attach tasting death long—if impossible at least rise before dawn to say Chatzos repair pairing night/day Torah as explained below.

I) Shabbat night one not awake Chatzos passing Chatzos asleep—doubt if kelipos dress tasting death—or Shabbat kelipos lack grip—Shaar HaKavanos Drushei Shabbat Shaar HaMitzvos Beshalach Mattan Torah … Amudei Eish letters … later saw Shoshanim §3 Drush 1 changing prayers note 8 no need rise Shabbat Chatzos night “night like day” no fear kelipos—see there; also Shoshanim §4 Petach Einayim Drush Chatzos—still Shabbat/Yom Tov strive Chatzos not cancel habit see siman 238 note 3.
